name: Matsumoto Yuuichi
source:
Assistant Director of the Matsumoto Clinic private hospital.
A physician whose notable characteristics are his stubble, wrinkled lab coat, and loose speaking style. A heavy smoker.
Even though he knows about her condition he still teases the protagonist, a frivolous delinquent doctor. It seems he actually does have skill however.
